existingContractBasis: supabase\migrations\0032_notification_centre.sql:24-40 returns at and data jsonb in list_my_notifications(int).

schemaAndLegacyBackfill: Add notifications.event_at as nullable timestamptz with DEFAULT NULL. Do not use NOT NULL DEFAULT now().
Leave event_at NULL on every pre-migration row. Preserve each exact stored created_at, updated_at, title, body and data; never copy updated_at into event_at or infer a historical last-collapse time.
NULL event_at is the storage-level created-at-only provenance marker. Historical at is exactly the known created_at, not a reconstructed last-event timestamp.
futureQueueWrites: New _queue_notification insert explicitly writes event_at=now(), recording the notification queue transaction time.

A genuine pending ON CONFLICT merge explicitly writes event_at=now() and read_at=NULL while preserving the original created_at. This also promotes an existing legacy pending row to a newly known queued-event timestamp.
A merge uses the actual database transaction timestamp; it need not invent a strictly greater value when two operations share a clock instant.

Transport claim/retry/finish/skip/receipt operations must not write event_at or created_at. queued_event means notification queued/merged time, not original business-event occurrence time or push delivery.

rpcProjection.signature: Keep list_my_notifications(p_limit int) and its existing RETURNS TABLE columns/types, owner checks and grants. Use CREATE OR REPLACE; do not drop/recreate the RPC.
rpcProjection.atAndOrdering: Return at=coalesce(event_at,created_at) and sort by that same value. Historical ordering is explicitly record-creation ordering, not recovered last-activity chronology.

markerValues.legacy_created_at: event_at IS NULL; at is the exact original notification-row created_at.
markerValues.queued_event: event_at IS NOT NULL; at is a known post-upgrade notification queue/merge transaction time.

rpcProjection.markerAuthority: For object data, overlay the server-derived marker in the RPC response after existing data, overriding any same-named payload key. Do not persist the overlay or rewrite stored historical data. If a malformed legacy data value is not an object, preserve it unchanged; the client uses unknown provenance and Time unavailable rather than guessing.

clientProjectionAndLabels.types: Keep AppNotification's existing RPC-facing field types. Extend internal NotificationItem with timeSource: 'legacy_created_at'|'queued_event'|'message_created_at'|'unknown'.
clientProjectionAndLabels.mapping: buildNotificationItems validates the projected marker for the timestamp it actually selects. Missing/invalid marker becomes unknown. If its existing chat timestamp selection chooses authoritative unread.last_message_at, use message_created_at instead; never retain the base row's marker for a substituted message timestamp. CM-T06 synthesized chat rows likewise mark a valid selected last_message_at as message_created_at.
clientProjectionAndLabels.sharedFormatter: Add notificationTimePresentation(item: Pick<NotificationItem,'at'|'timeSource'>, now: number, timeZone: string): {label:string,accessibilityLabel:string} in app\src\lib\unread.ts. Reuse shortAgo for the relative part; it alone cannot communicate provenance. Notifications pass Asia/Kolkata for exact-time formatting.
clientProjectionAndLabels.legacyAccessible: Notification record created <exact date/time with timezone>; latest historical activity time is unknown.
clientProjectionAndLabels.queuedAccessible: Notification event queued or merged <exact date/time with timezone>.
clientProjectionAndLabels.unknownOrInvalidTime: Show Time unavailable; accessibility says Notification time source is unavailable. Do not display a relative event time or put the row in a dated group; its group is Date unavailable.
clientProjectionAndLabels.flagBehavior: The provenance label and accessibility meaning are Class A and apply in the current Row and future NotificationCard with every Oorva switch OFF as well as ON. Never label a legacy timestamp Updated, Latest activity or Last event. Class-C date grouping uses the displayed timestamp basis; historical dated groups are labelled Records created Today/Yesterday/<date>, queued groups Activity recorded Today/Yesterday/<date>, and message groups Messages Today/Yesterday/<date>.
